Subject: Post-discovery: 30-min Redwood demo — scheduling (FinServCo)

Hi Alex/Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: you’re focused on improving inference latency for real-time scoring of transaction risk, preserving PII controls (VPC/KMS), and keeping monthly cost predictable as you scale. We covered the roadmap items and you confirmed the initial priority is a production-quality demo that shows latency, throughput, and the observability surface.

Next step: schedule a 30-minute product intro/demo where we can show Redwood’s serving runtime, routing/fallback behavior, and the Console’s per-route metrics. I’ve suggested two slots below — please pick one that works, or propose alternatives:

Option A: Thu Mar 19, 2026 — 10:00–10:30 PT
Option B: Fri Mar 20, 2026 — 14:00–14:30 PT

Attendees we recommend:
- Alex Johnson (Product Lead) — you
- Priya Singh (Security/Compliance) — to confirm controls
- Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer, Redwood) — will do the demo
- Vanessa Ortiz (AE, Redwood) — facilitator

Agenda (30m):
- 5m: quick context & goals
- 15m: live demo (latency, batching, routing, KV caching)
- 5m: Q&A / next steps (procurement, security questionnaire)

I attached a one-pager with relevant performance highlights. If you want a deeper technical deep-dive instead of the 30-min intro, we can schedule a 60–90 minute session with our infra team — let me know.

Thanks — looking forward to locking in a time.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
